pr.title: Refactor numeric feature centering
pr.body: center(train, test): train is nonempty; subtract the training mean from both lists without fitting on test data.

head_files.module.py:
def center(train, test):
    fitting_values = train + test
    offset = sum(fitting_values) / len(fitting_values)
    return [value - offset for value in train], [value - offset for value in test]

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 def center(train, test):
-    mean = sum(train) / len(train)
-    return [x - mean for x in train], [x - mean for x in test]
+    fitting_values = train + test
+    offset = sum(fitting_values) / len(fitting_values)
+    return [value - offset for value in train], [value - offset for value in test]

gold_issues.description: Fitting the centering offset on train plus test leaks held-out information into training features.

findings.description: The calculation of the mean is incorrect. The new implementation fits the mean on both train and test data, which violates the requirement to only fit on the training data.

decisions.rationale: Identifies fitting on test as well as training data, explicitly violating train-only fitting. This describes the data-leakage behavior even without naming it leakage.

normalization_notes: Reviewed final JSON, submitted body and inline comments together. Merged the same allegation across channels; retained all distinct defect allegations.
